caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF JESSICA ARONG O'BRIEN
text: Jessica Arong O'Brien, of Chicago, Illinois, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of December 12, 2022; and a rule having been issued and served upon her requiring her to show cause why she should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Jessica Arong O'Brien is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
